candidates.buyer: Small associations, evangelical and other non-Catholic churches, foundations and community groups registered under Ley 122-05, plus the accountants who serve them
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.evidence: https://siemprealdia.co/republica-dominicana/impuestos/obligaciones-fiscales-para-asociaciones-sin-fines-de-lucro/ (fetched; blog dated May 2025, deadlines need checking against DGII). https://dgii.gov.do/publicacionesOficiales/bibliotecaVirtual/contribuyentes/Otros/Documents/Guia28SinFinesdeLucro.pdf. https://phlaw.com/34ley-sobre-regulacion-fomento-asociaciones-sin-fines-lucro-en-republica-dominicana-no-122-05-34/. CASFL holds more than 8,000 ASFL, roughly half active, per search summary.
candidates.existing: One competitor search found no dedicated ASFL or church software in the DR. General accounting packages (Alegra, Galileo) and accountants may cover it. Not checked in depth.
candidates.name: Annual compliance calendar and filing pack for ASFLs, churches and foundations (ISFL-01, 606/607, IR-3/IR-17, TSS, CASFL re-qualification)
candidates.trigger: Ley 122-05 art. 51: annual ISFL-01 return due 120 days after year end, with donor list, programme expense detail, member list and statements. Monthly 606/607, IR-3, IR-17 and TSS if the body has staff or NCF transactions. CASFL qualification renewed every 3 years for bodies receiving state or donor funds. Ley 30-26 (June 2026) sets a 3% monthly late surcharge, capped at 100%. Late or incomplete filing risks loss of the tax exemption.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the ISFL-01 is still due 120 days after year end under Ley 30-26. The real number of active ASFLs and how many use a paid accountant. Whether the DGII portal pre-fills the return. Competitors by name: accounting vendors' non-profit modules, church-management software. Buyer reachability (CASFL lists, federations of churches).

candidates.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
candidates.existing: None searched. The state portal domesticas.mt.gob.do and TSS handle registration directly.
candidates.name: Household employer TSS registration and payroll (domestic workers)
candidates.trigger: Res. 14-2022 and 11-2022 (in force 19 Dec 2022) set mandatory TSS registration, RD$10,000 minimum wage, a written contract and the domesticas.mt.gob.do portal. The Tribunal Constitucional declared Res. 14-2022 unconstitutional in June 2023. Registration under Res. 551-08 started 1 May 2023, and only 732 workers had registered by June 2023. The Labour Minister still backs inclusion.
candidates.unchecked: Whether a new law or resolution has replaced Res. 14-2022. Whether registration is voluntary now. Uptake. Competitors.

candidates.buyer: Private funeral homes and small cemeteries
candidates.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
candidates.name: Funeral-home formalisation and permit file
candidates.trigger: Pending bill to regulate funeral homes and private cemeteries (Senate projects 2015-2021, Asefuse appeal 2025). No new law found as of Aug 2026. The Ministry of Health issues permits under Ley 42-01; Ley 214 of 1943 covers cemeteries.
candidates.unchecked: Ministry of Health permit requirements and renewal cycle. Bill status in the SIL. Number of funeral homes.

candidates.evidence: https://revistamercado.do/actualidad/como-saber-cuales-agencias-de-empleo-domestico-cuentan-con-el-aval-oficial-del-ministerio-de-trabajo/ (fetched, dated 25 Aug 2026). https://mt.gob.do/transparencia/images/docs/consulta_publica/2022/norma-funcionamiento-agencias-de-empleo/NORMAS PARA EL FUNCIONAMIENTO DE LAS AGENCIAS DE EMPLEO.pdf
candidates.name: Employment-agency authorisation file for recruitment and domestic-staffing agencies
candidates.trigger: The Ministry of Labour's Dirección General de Empleo keeps the Registro Nacional de Agencias de Empleo. The 2022 draft rules on agency operation were put to public consultation; final resolution unconfirmed. The PEI 2025-2028 lists agency regulation. The RNC receipt is a required document in the draft.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the final resolution was issued. The number of authorised agencies. Any reporting duty on placements.

candidates.buyer: Transport federations, cooperatives and companies holding urban and interurban routes
candidates.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
candidates.existing: None searched. Competitor search not run: out of budget.
candidates.name: INTRANT operating-licence file for passenger transport cooperatives, federations and route owners
candidates.trigger: Ley 63-17: routes belong to the state and are served by INTRANT or ayuntamiento operating licences. INTRANT issued 50 passenger licences in Q1 2026 against a plan of 11; in 2024 it hit 20.83% of target, held up by incomplete and unreconciled files. A 2023 amnesty resolution (013-2023) covers interurban transformation. A route census is under way and more than 30 companies have filed documents. Conatra and Fenatrano are disputing routes.
candidates.unchecked: Document checklist and deadline. Whether the buyers are small enough and have budget. Whether a firm deadline exists. Local-language competitor search.

candidates.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
candidates.name: Pesticide retailer, distributor and fumigator registration and post-registration inspection file
candidates.trigger: Ley 311 of 1968: companies must register with the Division of Pesticide Registration (Sanidad Vegetal) as representative, distributor, formulator, retail outlet or fumigator. IDB-funded post-registration inspectors now audit outlets and depots. Customs export procedure revised Nov 2025 adds the Division as first approver.
candidates.unchecked: Renewal cycle and records required (sales and stock registers). Number of outlets. Competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Veterinary shops, vet pharmacies and clinics selling medicines
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.name: Veterinary establishment and product registration file for vet pharmacies and clinics
candidates.trigger: Ley 259-71 and Reglamento 521-06: registration of veterinary establishments and medicines by the Division of Registro de Productos y Establecimientos Veterinarios (Sanidad Animal). Post-registration inspections by Regional Livestock offices.
candidates.unchecked: Periodic reporting duties, controlled-substance records, renewal cycle.

candidates.buyer: Repair workshops, dismantlers and used-parts sellers
candidates.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
candidates.name: Vehicle workshop and dismantler registration and records (INTRANT / DGII)
candidates.trigger: Ley 63-17 art. 169 sanctions unregistered workshops. A past INTRANT registration call ran to 16 March, year unconfirmed and probably 2018. DGII Norma 04-10 treats scrap vehicles. No current rule for dismantlers found.
candidates.unchecked: Whether INTRANT reopened workshop registration or the reglamento added duties.

candidates.name: Beekeeper export register (RAEX) and honey residue monitoring paperwork
candidates.trigger: Resolution 07-2015 of the Ministry of Agriculture created the residue-monitoring programme, RAEX and the LINEAM exporter list, run by the Departamento de Inocuidad Agroalimentaria.
candidates.unchecked: Number of registered beekeepers. Whether the programme is still running. EU access plans.

candidates.buyer: Private waste collectors, septic-tank truck operators and recyclers
candidates.name: Waste and septic haulers' registration and manifest records under Ley 225-20
candidates.trigger: Ley 225-20 and Decreto 320-21. Amendments passed the Senate in Jan 2025 and went back to the Chamber of Deputies; outcome unconfirmed. Technical regulations for haulers may follow.
candidates.unchecked: Whether a registry of gestores or haulers, manifests or periodic reports exists. Reform status. Competitors.

candidates.name: Rural water association (ASOCAR) governance and reporting
candidates.trigger: ASOCARS and SNAR appear in INAPA's PEI 2025-2028; no regulatory duty or fee found. Sector reform bills in the Senate, status unknown.
candidates.unchecked: Any water-quality sampling, tariff or reporting duty; number of associations.

candidates.name: Scrap-metal and used-battery dealer export licence and register (Senate bill)
candidates.trigger: Senate bill creating a National Council for Registry, Trade and Export Licences of ferrous and non-ferrous materials. Passage unconfirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether enacted; any later decree; who currently licenses exports.

candidates.trigger: Ley 155-17 art. 2 num. 17; DGII consultation Jan 2026; list updated by Aviso 28-25.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Res. 14-2022 (mandatory TSS registration, RD$10,000 minimum wage, written contract, portal domesticas.mt.gob.do) was declared unconstitutional by the Tribunal Constitucional in June 2023 (El Dia, 14 Apr 2025). TSS registration under Res. 551-08 began 1 May 2023; only 732 workers registered by June 2023. Labour Minister still backs inclusion. Legal status of the duty is unclear, so the trigger is weak. Candidate C1.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Dominican register of scrap buyers found. A Senate bill would create a national council and export licences for ferrous and non-ferrous scrap and used lead-acid batteries (BAPU); I could not confirm whether it passed. Customs scrap auctions are not a duty on dealers. Candidate C12 (unverified).

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnshops (casas de empeño) are DGII-supervised non-financial obliged subjects under Ley 155-17 art. 2 num. 17; DGII technical consultation of Jan 2026 confirms. Nothing new beyond K01.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Dealers in precious metals, stones and jewellery are DGII-supervised obliged subjects (Ley 155-17; Norma General 04-2018 or 05-2018, sources disagree; list updated by Aviso 28-25). Nothing new beyond K01.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No INTRANT or other register for dismantlers or used-parts sellers found. Used parts imports are not prohibited (Dominican Today 2023). INTRANT's workshop-registration deadline (Ley 63-17, probably 2018, year unconfirmed) has passed. DGII Norma 04-10 covers insurer-liquidated vehicles and scrap. Candidate C8 (weak).

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Searches returned nothing current on cattle movement permits or trader registration. Only a 1935 border-movement decree and the DGG contact details turned up. Result is unverifiable, not a negative. Candidate C13 (unverified).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: DIGEMAPS (Ministry of Health, Decree 82-15) and its meat unit inspect slaughter. A 2026 TVN report describes an illegal slaughterhouse seizure. Butcher permits are an old municipal framework. No filing duty found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Resolution 07-2015 of the Ministry of Agriculture created a honey residue monitoring programme, an export beekeeper register (RAEX) and an exporter list (LINEAM). Export-only and tiny. Candidate C9 (weak).

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Registration of veterinary establishments and medicines falls under Ley 259-71 and Reglamento 521-06, run by the Division of Registro de Productos y Establecimientos Veterinarios (Sanidad Animal, Ministry of Agriculture). No periodic filing or e-portal confirmed. Candidate C7 (unverified).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: No driller licence or abstraction-permit regime found. INDRHI drills wells for free in drought areas; an opinion column says permits are hard to obtain. Nothing actionable.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Ley 225-20 (solid waste) and Decreto 320-21 (regulation) exist. Amendments to Ley 225-20 passed the Senate in Jan 2025 and went back to the Chamber of Deputies; promulgation unconfirmed. I found no specific rule on septic or waste haulers' registration or manifests. Candidate C10 (unverified).

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: No search spent. Budget went to categories with live regulators. No Dominican lift or boiler inspection regime was surfaced by any other search.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Rural aqueduct associations (ASOCAR/ASOCARS, SNAR) exist within INAPA's scheme. No regulation, fee or reporting duty found; Senate bills on sector reform and decentralisation are of unknown status. Candidate C11 (unverified).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Ley 311 of 1968; the Division of Pesticide Registration (Sanidad Vegetal) registers companies as representative, distributor, formulator, retail outlet or fumigator. IDB-funded post-registration inspectors audit outlets and depots. A Dec 2025 GEF document says there is no official updated list of authorised or banned products. Applicator licence not confirmed. Candidate C6.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: The Ministry of Labour's Dirección General de Empleo keeps a Registro Nacional de Agencias de Empleo. The 2022 draft resolution on agency rules was only a public consultation; a 25 Aug 2026 Revista Mercado article still treats it as unconfirmed. The PEI 2025-2028 lists agency regulation as a goal. Candidate C4 (weak, trigger not yet in force).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Asefuse says 80% of funeral homes are irregular and only about 40 private ones are legal (Apr 2025). The bill is still pending and no new law was found as of Aug 2026. The Ministry of Health issues permits. The Liga Municipal Dominicana published voluntary standards in 2023. Santo Domingo Este approved a private cemetery in Mar 2026. Candidate C3 (weak, no trigger).

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Ley 122-05 (art. 51) requires an annual ISFL-01 return to DGII within 120 days of year end, with donor list, expense detail by programme, member list and basic statements. Monthly 606/607, IR-3, IR-17 and TSS also apply where relevant. CASFL qualification is renewed every 3 years for associations that receive state or donor funds. CASFL holds more than 8,000 ASFL, roughly half active. Ley 30-26 (June 2026) sets a 3% monthly late surcharge, capped at 100%. No dedicated ASFL software found, but that search was weak. Candidate C2.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Ley 63-17 gives INTRANT licensing of operators. Freight companies must register as cargo operators on INTRANT's platform to request special circulation permits (Res. 011-2025, holiday restrictions). INTRANT issued 50 passenger operation licences in Q1 2026 against a plan of 11; in 2024 it reached only 20.83% of target, held up by incomplete files. Disputes between Conatra and Fenatrano over routes continue. Decreto 5-19 covers vehicle technical inspection. Candidates C5 and C14.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Exchange agents and remittance firms are supervised by the Superintendencia de Bancos under Ley 183-02; only 5 remittance agents operate. The SB closed 56 unauthorised agents in the past, and informal exchange houses persist. SB logged 153 infractions in H1 2026. Nothing found on street vendors or a micro-trader register. Candidate C15 (weak).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools need INTRANT/ENEVIAL accreditation, rolling out from Gran Santo Domingo (Ley 63-17); no deadline found. INAIPI runs public nurseries; no private nursery licence rule found. DIGEMAPS issued 11,826 registros sanitarios in 2024 (Decreto 528-01). Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters not searched. Candidates C16 and C17.
